# Nursing and Midwifery Enterprise Agreement

On this page

On 30 April 2025, formal negotiations commenced for a new enterprise agreement to replace [Nursing/Midwifery (South Australian Public Sector) Enterprise Agreement 2022 (PDF 10MB)](https://www.sahealth.sa.gov.au/wps/wcm/connect/public+content/sa+health+internet/resources/nursing+midwifery+south+australian+public+sector+enterprise+agreement+2022) which nominally expired on 31 July 2025

## Process for negotiations

As required as part of the Fair Work Act 1994 (SA), a [Notice of Intention to Bargain (PDF 650KB)](https://www.sahealth.sa.gov.au/wps/wcm/connect/public+content/sa+health+internet/resources/notice+of+intention+to+bargain+-+nmea+2025) was issued on 10 April 2025. The Notice identified the employees who are proposed to be covered by the new enterprise agreement and their right to representation. Employees can be represented by an employee association under the Fair Work Act 1994 (SA) or an agent of their choice.

The ballot for a proposed replacement Agreement commenced 9:00 am (ACST) Monday 20 July 2026 and will close 5:00 pm (ACST) Wednesday 29 July 2026.

If a majority of employees to be covered by the proposed Agreement vote in the ballot to support the proposed new Agreement (i.e., vote Yes) an application will be made to the South Australian Employment Tribunal (SAET) for it to be approved. The proposed agreement only has effect when it is approved by the SAET.

Further progress updates on bargaining will be published on this web page.
